mixing_test: two-sided binomial for n_A | n with p0 = global P(A); Bonferroni per tau
note_tau_interpretation: tau is cophenetic distance cut (scipy fcluster criterion=distance). Grid scans from large tau (few clusters) to small tau (more clusters). tau_first_mixing_fail_scan_high_to_low: first grid point (coarse-to-fine order) where a cluster fails the A/B binomial test. tau_finest_mixing_pass_on_grid: smallest tau on the grid where all clusters still pass.
